author: LIDIYA-INNER-CORE-ARCHITECT
scope: Minimum Builder-implementable offline replay/reconnect acceptance matrix for NavLite G3/G4 and Small-Nest offline-first continuity.
global_invariants: MISSION_STATE plus current pending packet remain formal authority.
Offline/unverified state may ASK, FLAG and perform read-only reflection only.
No offline event may authorize durable promotion, cross-device adoption, personality/base write, governance mutation or external action.
Reconnection never restores authority automatically; every event must be revalidated against fresh authority, provenance, TTL, contradiction and dedupe state.
Old immutable offline envelopes remain evidence pointers; successful revalidation produces a new event/version rather than in-place mutation.
Recurrence/emotion/influence never substitute for trust or authority.

canonical_hash_rule.rule: Hash a versioned canonical serialization of every resume_fingerprint_canonical_fields member in fixed field order; representation, hash algorithm and normalization rules remain TEST_REQUIRED until independently benchmarked/verified.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: same dedupe_key and payload_digest already processed or held
acceptance_matrix.notes: May update non-authoritative replay diagnostics only; must not repeat ASK, handoff, promotion or action.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: expires_at <= trusted_now after reconnect or trusted local clock check
acceptance_matrix.notes: If still referenced by evidence/rollback/verifier, retain pointer but keep zero promotion/action eligibility. TTL defaults and clock-skew tolerance are TEST_REQUIRED.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: fresh source fingerprint differs from immutable event source_fingerprint
acceptance_matrix.notes: A newly fetched source may create a separate candidate event only after fresh provenance/trust evaluation; old event is not rewritten.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: fresh MISSION_STATE/current pending packet SHA differs from event authority_pointer or resume fingerprint
acceptance_matrix.notes: Discard continuation assumptions, fresh-route against new formal authority and never let the old event overwrite current mission state.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: new independent evidence credibly resolves prior confirmed contradiction
acceptance_matrix.notes: New event/version only after fresh provenance, trust, TTL and authority checks. Prior recurrence/emotion/influence provides no release credit. Formal personality/base promotion remains forbidden here.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: cursor decreases, skips un-dispositioned events, or advances without idempotent processing proof
acceptance_matrix.notes: Cursor must be monotonic and only advance after explicit disposition. Allowed cursor gap/window is TEST_REQUIRED.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: portable_schema_version is not within independently verified compatibility set
acceptance_matrix.notes: No direct replay. Migration must create a new candidate envelope and preserve old evidence. Compatibility matrix is TEST_REQUIRED.

cross_model_portability_requirement.proposal: Require deterministic semantic-state conformance in addition to byte/hash authority equivalence.
cross_model_portability_requirement.rule: Different model wording is allowed; the conformance vector must remain identical for the same verified inputs before cross-model resume/adoption is accepted.

builder_tests_required: expired TTL cannot promote or act
formal pending SHA mismatch forces rebase
cleared contradiction yields new candidate version only
schema incompatibility yields migration candidate only
offline mode never produces protected write/external action
same verified input across two conforming backends yields identical semantic-state conformance vector
claim_boundary: Quantum research candidate only. Does not modify formal Step-003 acceptance, does not consume packets, and is not Builder or C PASS.
